name: original-R1-R2-and-atomicity-probe
argv:
import errno, importlib.util, json, os, shutil, struct, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock
from zipfile import BadZipFile, ZipFile, ZIP_DEFLATED
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
work=Path.cwd()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('reviewed_packet',work/'packet_import.py')
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
def snapshot(parent):
    return {p.relative_to(parent).as_posix():('dir' if p.is_dir() else p.read_bytes().hex()) for p in parent.rglob('*')}
observed={}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='review-probe-',dir=work) as temporary:
    root=Path(temporary);parent=root/'collections';parent.mkdir()
    (parent/'keep.txt').write_bytes(b'pre-existing neighbor\n')
    archive=root/'good.zip'
    members=[('first.txt',b'complete first payload\n'),('folder/second.txt',b'second payload with more bytes\n')]
    with ZipFile(archive,'w',compression=ZIP_DEFLATED) as packet:
        for name,data in members:packet.writestr(name,data)
    target=parent/'received';before=snapshot(parent)
    handles=[];copies=[];cleanups=[]
    real_copy=shutil.copyfileobj;real_cleanup=shutil.rmtree;real_rename=os.rename
    def partial_copy(source,output,*args,**kwargs):
        handles.extend((source,output));copies.append(output.name)
        assert not os.path.lexists(target)
        if len(copies)==1:return real_copy(source,output,*args,**kwargs)
        output.write(source.read(7));output.flush()
        raise OSError(errno.ENOSPC,'review partial-write failure')
    def observe_cleanup(path,*args,**kwargs):
        cleanups.append(snapshot(Path(path)))
        return real_cleanup(path,*args,**kwargs)
    with mock.patch.object(module.shutil,'copyfileobj',side_effect=partial_copy), mock.patch.object(module.shutil,'rmtree',side_effect=observe_cleanup):
        try:module.import_packet(archive,target)
        except OSError as error:assert error.errno==errno.ENOSPC
        else:raise AssertionError('partial write failure not propagated')
    assert len(copies)==2 and len(cleanups)==1
    assert cleanups[0]['first.txt']==members[0][1].hex()
    assert cleanups[0]['folder/second.txt']==members[1][1][:7].hex()
    assert all(handle.closed for handle in handles)
    assert snapshot(parent)==before and not os.path.lexists(target)
    observed['partial_write']='ENOSPC after full first file and seven flushed bytes of second; streams closed; staging removed; destination absent; parent unchanged'
    placements=[]
    def placement(source,destination,fail=False):
        source=Path(source);destination=Path(destination)
        assert source.parent==destination.parent==parent
        assert not os.path.lexists(destination)
        assert all((source/name).read_bytes()==data for name,data in members)
        placements.append('complete sibling tree and absent destination')
        if fail:raise OSError(errno.EACCES,'review placement failure')
        return real_rename(source,destination)
    with mock.patch.object(module.os,'rename',side_effect=lambda a,b:placement(a,b,True)):
        try:module.import_packet(archive,target)
        except OSError as error:assert error.errno==errno.EACCES
        else:raise AssertionError('placement failure not propagated')
    assert snapshot(parent)==before and not os.path.lexists(target)
    observed['placement_failure']='EACCES after observing complete staging; staging removed; destination absent; parent unchanged'
    with mock.patch.object(module.os,'rename',side_effect=placement):
        assert module.import_packet(archive,target)==sorted(name for name,_ in members)
    assert len(placements)==2
    assert all((target/name).read_bytes()==data for name,data in members)
    observed['write_placement_retry']='same destination successfully imported after restoring normal I/O; complete bytes verified at placement and final paths'
    damaged=root/'damaged-deflate.zip';raw=bytearray(archive.read_bytes())
    with ZipFile(archive) as packet:
        info=packet.getinfo('first.txt')
        name_length,extra_length=struct.unpack_from('<HH',raw,info.header_offset+26)
        offset=info.header_offset+30+name_length+extra_length
    raw[offset]=(raw[offset]&0xF9)|0x06;damaged.write_bytes(raw)
    bad_target=parent/'corrupt-retry';before_bad=snapshot(parent)
    try:module.import_packet(damaged,bad_target)
    except (BadZipFile,ValueError,OSError) as error:
        observed['R1']={'exception':type(error).__name__,'message':str(error),'cause':type(error.__cause__).__module__+'.'+type(error.__cause__).__name__}
    else:raise AssertionError('damaged DEFLATE must raise a documented error')
    assert snapshot(parent)==before_bad
    cli=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B',str(work/'packet_import.py'),'import',str(damaged),str(bad_target)],cwd=work,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=15)
    observed['R2']={'exit_code':cli.returncode,'stdout':cli.stdout,'stderr':cli.stderr}
    assert cli.returncode!=0 and cli.stderr and not cli.stdout and 'Traceback' not in cli.stderr
    assert snapshot(parent)==before_bad
    assert module.import_packet(archive,bad_target)==sorted(name for name,_ in members)
    assert all((bad_target/name).read_bytes()==data for name,data in members)
    assert (parent/'keep.txt').read_bytes()==b'pre-existing neighbor\n'
    observed['corruption_cleanup_retry']='API and CLI preserve the whole parent; no destination or staging remains on failure; corrected archive succeeds at same path'
print(json.dumps(observed,indent=2))
